prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "potential". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "potential".
Scene: A promising young adult musician practicing violin with a teacher, a faint aspirational inset of the same musician playing confidently on stage, clearly future possibility.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "potential has the same spelling; picture ability that can develop.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon har stor potential som musiker.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
